annotation.bound_parties_text: The statute binds any person who knowingly and intentionally causes an unmanned aircraft system to enter property, airspace or restricted areas.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Any person who knowingly and intentionally causes an unmanned aircraft system to (i) enter the property of another and come within 50 feet of a dwelling house
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Trespass with an unmanned aircraft system; penalty.
